rounds.diagnosis: Stage-to-stage continuity fails on orientation: the transport subgoal allows the pen to be tilted up to +/-15 deg from the cup axis, while the insert stage's path region only admits +/-5 deg, so a legal exit pose of the transport stage can lie outside the region in which the insert motion is allowed to move (and a 15 deg lean over the rim is a poor pre-insertion pose anyway). Tighten the transport subgoal rotation row to tight so the handoff pose is always inside the insert path region.

In the transport stage the path rotation row constrains marker.up_axis (the marker's lateral axis) to cup.up_axis, which nominally demands a horizontal marker and is inconsistent with both the upright entry pose and the upright subgoal (which uses marker.front_axis). The resulting compiled band (roll -30 to +120 deg) admits poses with the marker lying flat or leaning far over the rim, so nothing keeps the long axis near vertical during the approach. Re-pick the path rotation row's constrained direction to marker.+front so the path matches the entry, the goal, and the following insert stage.
